records.name: Sullivam
records.tagline: AI-powered automation for modern businesses
records.description: Sullivam helps businesses simplify daily operations with intelligent digital workers. Automate repetitive tasks, process invoices, validate business rules, and streamline workflows while keeping people in control

records.name: HexColor Pro
records.tagline: Free color picker, palettes, gradients & contrast checks
records.description: HexColor Pro is a free, browser-based color toolkit for designers and front-end developers. Pick colors, build palettes and CSS gradients, check WCAG contrast, convert formats, and generate shadows—without creating an account. Made for everyday design and coding work: fast, privacy-friendly, and ready in the browser.

records.name: Optiexpense
records.tagline: Finance
records.description: Optiexpense — Private Finance Know exactly how much you can spend today. Optiexpense shows a real-time "Safe to Spend" number — your income, minus upcoming bills, minus debt payments, minus a safety buffer. No guessing. No spreadsheets. Everything runs on your iPhone. No account, no sign-in, no tracking, and no subscription. Your financial data never leaves your device, with an optional private backup to your own iCloud.

records.name: ResuMatch
records.tagline: AI Application analyzes resumes.
records.description: The Problem: Job seekers struggle to tailor resumes, and recruiters spend hours manually checking for skill gaps. Who it's for: Developers and teams looking for an open-source tool to automate resume screening. Key Features: Upload PDF/DOCX resumes to compare against job descriptions for match scores. Apache Tika text extraction and Apache OpenNLP skill tagging. Spring Boot 3, PostgreSQL, and stateless JWT role-based security. Swagger UI and Docker support. (478 characters)

records.name: Footballdle
records.tagline: Guess the footballer. A new one every day.
records.description: Footballdle is the daily football guessing game. A new mystery player drops at midnight: guess their surname in six tries, with green and amber tiles showing how close you are. Then play Scout Report, Spot the Baller and The Grid, a 3x3 of clubs and countries with five new grids every Saturday. Collect Player Cards, unlock 57 trophies and climb the Game Center leaderboards. Free on iPhone, no ads, no account. Android and computers play on the website.

records.name: Renovation Cost Calculator PRO
records.tagline: Plan renovation costs and track budgets in Excel
records.description: Plan renovation budgets with an Excel calculator. Estimate material and labor costs, track expenses, and organize project budgets. Designed for homeowners and contractors. Supports USD, EUR, and UAH.

records.name: Free Gift Card Giveaway 2026: Win $2,000
records.tagline: Free Gift Card Giveaway 2026: Win $2,000 in 7 Countries
records.description: Our giveaway is open to Argentina, Indonesia, Turkey, Vietnam, the USA, Canada and Germany. Enter free to win $2,000.

records.name: HiCrush
records.tagline: Stop swiping. Let’s date.
records.description: A dating app for people around the world who want real dates and real relationships. English-language profiles, fewer and better introductions, compatibility you can understand, and safety tools that are always free.

records.name: Entrepreneurial Hub
records.tagline: Free Accounting and Financial Calculation Tools
records.description: Entrepreneurial Hub provides practical accounting and financial tools designed to simplify everyday financial calculations and business analysis.

records.name: Hygular
records.tagline: Independent Frontend UI Engine
records.description: Build cohesive interfaces with semantic utility CSS, reusable components, and a lightweight JavaScript runtime. Framework freedom, optional React integration.

records.name: Tinward
records.tagline: A personal finance app in development
records.description: Personal finance app for Android, in early development. Transaction tracking today, a wider financial picture in development.

records.name: Quality & Speed Controls for HBO Max
records.tagline: Choose HBO Max quality & speed yourself. Free, no tracking
records.description: HBO Max picks your video quality from your connection and has no speed control. This free Chrome extension lets you lock the quality you want, switch it in ~2 seconds without reloading, and watch at 1×–2×. Ads stay at normal speed. No data collected.

records.name: CyberDragon.ai
records.tagline: AI-powered cybersecurity for OT, ICS and critical structure
records.description: CyberDragon.ai is an industrial cybersecurity platform that provides passive OT visibility, SIEM/SOAR, cyber threat intelligence, enterprise-to-OT attack detection, compliance evidence and quantum-resilient identity for industrial and critical infrastructure environments.

records.name: Terriloom
records.tagline: Project Management tool that plugs straight into your AI.
records.description: Track and ship project items using boards, custom fields, calendar, comments and team chat, with your coding AI working on the items alongside you.

records.name: Wings Chess
records.tagline: Learn chess with an AI coach that explains every move
records.description: Wings Chess is a free chess coach that explains every move in plain English. Stockfish finds the moves and the AI only explains what the engine has verified, so it never invents a line. - 92 lessons across 5 levels, from your first move to club level - Import your Lichess or Chess.com games and the mistakes you repeat become puzzles - 10 bots that play and blunder like real players from 400 to 2000 - Play a friend with one link, no download

records.name: Calkey
records.tagline: Type your meal like a note. Get calories and macros.
records.description: Calkey is an Android calorie and macro tracker you write into. One sentence in your own language, with your own kitchen's measures, becomes calories, protein, carbs and fat. Every number is an estimate you can fix in two taps, and the app never comments on what you ate.

records.name: Tagg
records.tagline: Never forget who you met
records.description: Tagg is a people memory with a personal agent. Make your card once, then anyone you meet scans your QR code and gets your links, no app for them to install. Tagg saves the moment: when you met, where, and at which event, plus your private voice or text notes and a selfie. Later, just ask: who did I meet at Cal Hacks who works on robotics? Tagg answers with their card, the context, and why you should follow up. Free, installable on any phone.

records.name: Is This $2,000 Gift Card Giveaway Real?
records.tagline: Is This $2,000 Gift Card Giveaway Real? How It Works
records.description: No fees, no deposits, a random draw, a public winner announcement and clear rules. See how our giveaway works before you enter.

records.name: Named Routes
records.tagline: Turn your pages into typed, named URLs
records.description: Generate typed URL helpers from the pages your framework already routes. Discover routes across Next.js, Nuxt, Vue, SvelteKit, Astro, React Router and TanStack Router, with typed parameters, locale-aware URLs and zero runtime dependencies.

records.name: Cutout Studio
records.tagline: Remove backgrounds. Edit photos. Free & private.
records.description: Free, private background remover & photo editor that runs in your browser.

records.name: VisiHost
records.tagline: Affordable Hosting for Developers, Gamers & Businesses
records.description: VisiHost is a hosting platform offering affordable infrastructure solutions, including VPS hosting, Discord bot hosting, Telegram bot hosting, Minecraft server hosting, Lavalink hosting and database hosting. Built to make hosting accessible to developers, gaming communities and businesses.

records.name: Invoice Number Generator
records.tagline: Free sequential invoice numbers, no sign-up needed
records.description: Automatic sequential invoice numbering tool with customizable patterns, zero-padding, and collision prevention.

records.name: Your Flex Expert
records.tagline: Find Flexible Workspaces Across the UK & Ireland
records.description: Discover how to rent office space across the UK with ease and confidence. Your Flex Expert guides you to the right workspace.

records.name: High Valyrian Translator
records.tagline: Free High Valyrian translator with dictionary and phrases
records.description: High Valyrian Translators is a free online translator for the language of House Targaryen from Game of Thrones and House of the Dragon. Translate English into High Valyrian and back, look up words in a 400-word dictionary built from the show's canon, learn famous phrases like valar morghulis and dracarys, and try the name and sword generators. It also translates Dothraki.

records.name: PunjabTest
records.tagline: Free practice tests and chapter-wise study guides
records.description: PunjabTest is an educational platform for students in Pakistan, offering online practice tests, chapter-wise learning resources, and board exam preparation tools to make studying easier.

records.name: $2,000 Gift Card Winner Announced
records.tagline: $2,000 Gift Card Winner Announced November 22
records.description: Entries closed November 20. See who won the $2,000 gift card in our free giveaway. Thanks to everyone who entered.

records.name: Facerizer
records.tagline: Facerizer | AI Grooming Coach
records.description: Facerizer is an AI grooming and style coach. You upload a clear photo, and it detects your face shape, describes your visible facial features, and recommends hairstyles, beard styles, glasses and general skincare habits, with a step-by-step improvement plan.

records.name: MLive Indonesia
records.tagline: Panduan MLiveU berbahasa Indonesia
records.description: Portal informasi MLiveU dalam bahasa Indonesia, dengan panduan akun dan rujukan produk. Situs bacaan independen, bukan aplikasi streaming atau pengembangnya.

records.name: Business Plan Locatif
records.tagline: Business plan immobilier gratuit, prêt pour la banque
records.description: Outil en ligne gratuit, sans inscription, pour construire le business plan d'un investissement locatif : rentabilité, cash-flow, comparaison de la location nue, du LMNP et de la SCI à l'IS, profil bancaire, revente et export PDF.

records.name: How to Win a $2,000 Gift Card: 3 Simple
records.tagline: How to Win a $2,000 Gift Card: 3 Simple Steps
records.description: Fill in the form, share the page and leave a comment for bonus entries. Free to enter for readers in 7 eligible countries.

records.name: Vilva D2C
records.tagline: Storefront, payments and WhatsApp in one Indian D2C stack
records.description: Vilva D2C is an Indian ecommerce platform that puts the storefront, payments, shipping and WhatsApp marketing in one admin, with pricing in rupees from ₹799/month. A Shopify alternative built for Indian D2C brands.

records.name: FocusLens
records.tagline: See where your focus actually goes on your Mac
records.description: FocusLens tracks the apps you use on your Mac and turns your day into a 0–100 focus score: deep work, context switches, distractions and streaks. Set goals, get coaching tips, export PDF/CSV reports. All data stays on your Mac. $19.99 once.

records.name: Last Hours: Win a $2,000 Gift Card, Free
records.tagline: Last Hours: Win a $2,000 Gift Card, Free Entry
records.description: The giveaway closes November 20, 2026 at 11:59 PM UTC. Enter free for a chance to win a $2,000 gift card.

records.name: Concrete Calculator
records.tagline: Free concrete calculators: yards, bags and cost
records.description: Free concrete calculators for slabs, footings, post holes and stairs. Get cubic yards, whole bag counts and cost at your own prices, plus whether bags or a ready-mix truck is cheaper. Metric for post holes. No sign-up, and it can be embedded on any site.

records.name: TrackPin
records.tagline: Amazon price history with a verdict, not just a chart
records.description: Know if an Amazon price is actually good. Price trackers give you a chart; TrackPin gives you the answer: today's price against what the product normally sells for, as Great, Good, Normal or Above normal. Free, no sign-up, with alerts and an API.

records.name: StockVirtue
records.tagline: StockVirtue – Learn | Practice | Invest Better
records.description: **StockVirtue – Learn | Practice | Invest Better** StockVirtue is a financial learning and virtual trading platform designed to help people understand the stock market and develop better trading skills. 🌐 Website: https://stockvirtue.com *StockVirtue is an educational and virtual trading platform. We do not provide guaranteed returns or investment advice.*

records.name: Glint
records.tagline: Learn Morse code in 13 hours
records.description: Glint teaches Morse code using the Koch method: every character at full speed from day one, added one at a time, via six milestones from First Steps to a real on-air conversation. You can practise by sound, by vibration or by flash. It also decodes Morse from the camera or the microphone, works out the sender's speed, and signals back with the screen or the flashlight.

records.name: Omega Media: Video Compressor
records.tagline: Offline video compressor, MP3 converter & photo resizer
records.description: Omega Media is an offline video compressor, video to MP3 converter, MP3 cutter and photo resizer in one app. Shrink big videos, pull the audio out of a clip, trim songs and resize photos on your phone. Your files are processed on the device, and no account is needed. Omega Media works on Android 7.0 and above. Questions or ideas? Write to mugavaristudio@gmail.com.

records.name: DePayLink
records.tagline: Accept SOL & USDC on Solana with a simple payment link.
records.description: DePayLink is a non-custodial crypto payment-link platform built on Solana. Businesses and independent professionals use it to create payment links for products and services, share them with customers, and receive SOL or USDC directly in their own Solana wallet. It removes the need to build and maintain your own payment interface and blockchain verification. DePayLink is not a card processor, bank, custodial wallet, exchange or fiat payment gateway.

records.name: Spectre
records.tagline: AI-powered study companion for smarter learning
records.description: Spectre AI is an all-in-one AI study platform designed to help students learn smarter. Create summaries, exercises, tests, study materials and more. Explore a new way to organize your learning with AI.

records.name: Levelkin
records.tagline: Build habits with a companion that grows with you
records.description: Levelkin turns daily habits into progress for a little companion. Track your routines, earn XP toward level 100, and see your progress in heatmaps and reports.

records.name: BDS Finance
records.tagline: Personal finance with cash or accrual books, plus rentals
records.description: A personal finance app built by an accountant. Bank feeds, budgets, investments and net worth, plus accrual accounting, a tax report, an AI assistant and a rentals module with rent roll, deposits and Schedule E. Try it with sample data.

records.name: Best Vertical Electric Towel Warmer
records.tagline: Vertical Electric Towel Warmer, Vertical Towel Warmer
records.description: The Vertical Electric Heated Towel Rail from Index Bath combines modern style with smart functionality. Its space-saving 3-rod design, stainless steel construction, and adjustable heating control keep towels warm and dry. Available with optional WiFi connectivity for added convenience.

records.name: Omni Tools
records.tagline: free online tools platform offering 85+ useful web tools,
records.description: OmniTools.pk is a comprehensive online platform designed to make everyday digital tasks easier, faster, and more convenient. It offers a growing collection of 85+ free online tools that help users perform a wide range of tasks without installing additional software or creating complicated workflows. Whether you need to calculate something, convert files or values, generate useful content, or complete everyday online tasks, OmniTools.pk provides simple and accessible solutions in one place.

records.name: Hassist
records.tagline: A daily companion for your parents
records.description: A daily companion and elder companion for parents in India. Maya, an AI companion, calls every day in Hindi or their language, and your parent can call her 24/7 whenever they need help. The family gets an update after every call. Start a 3-day trial.

records.name: Swept
records.tagline: Swipe through your camera roll to clean it up
records.description: Swept turns cleaning your iPhone camera roll into swiping: left to bin, right to keep, up to a private vault locked with Face ID. Videos play right on the card, Smart Triage spots blurry shots, bursts and screenshots, and near-duplicates are grouped on the device. Nothing is deleted until you empty Swept's own Trash, and your photos are never uploaded. Free with ads; Swept Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.

records.name: Nash
records.tagline: Game-theoretic AI token pricing & margin simulator
records.description: Most AI startups pick a flat $20/mo tier and get crushed by whale token burn, or switch to pure usage meters and lose users to bill-shock. Nash is a 100% browser-native AI FinOps workbench that simulates 1,000 log-normal agents using Kahneman-Tversky loss aversion and 2-tier self-selection math. Test 18 real LLM routing stacks, parse private CSV logs locally, run a 240-combination Nash grid-search optimizer, and export production TypeScript router middleware.

records.name: Aisley
records.tagline: Plan your whole wedding inside ChatGPT or Claude
records.description: Plan your wedding inside ChatGPT or Claude. Aisley finds real venues, emails them from your Gmail once you confirm, reads the replies, chases quiet ones and keeps the budget. Works in the web app too. £10 a month per wedding, free trial, no card.

records.name: Gym Flooring
records.tagline: Get Premium Gym Rubber Flooring in Dubai
records.description: Are you looking best shock-absorbent Gym Flooring Dubai? Get heavy-duty gym rubber flooring for your residential and commercial gym and fitness spaces.

records.name: PehnoAI
records.tagline: Wear what you own. Buy only what works.
records.description: Pehno: Less closet, more wear. Stop buying clothes that don't go with anything you own. Pehno is an AI stylist that knows your wardrobe, so you spend less and always have something to wear. Check before you buy. Paste a product link and get a buy or skip verdict based on what you own. Outfits from your own clothes. Pick an occasion and weather and get looks you can wear today. Pack in one tap. Trip presets with a day-by-day outfit plan. Private, and free to start.

records.name: Backpulse
records.tagline: We turned TradingView into a quantitative backtesting lab
records.description: Backpulse turns TradingView into an automated backtest engine — right in your browser. Auto-scans any Pine Script strategy → set Min/Max/Step ranges → runs Brute Force or Bayesian ML sweeps → ranked leaderboard by Net Profit, Sharpe & Drawdown → 1-click apply to chart. New: ☁️ Cloud Mode for 10,000+ iteration sweeps while you sleep. ⚡ Local Mode: 100% private, zero data leaves your machine. Free. No coding. No API keys.

records.name: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
records.tagline: Multimodal AI video from prompts and image refs
records.description: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash turns a shot brief plus up to seven image references into coherent 4–10s clips up to 4K (16:9 or 9:16). Keep faces, products, and palettes consistent; refine camera moves and scenes without starting over. Draft at 720p, finish at 1080p or 4K. Same studio hosts GPT Image / Seedream stills and Seedance when you need synced audio. Start free with creator credits, then pay per clip. Independent site — not an official Google product.

records.name: 0work
records.tagline: Model-agnostic AI agent for your files, browser and apps
records.description: 0work is a desktop AI agent for Mac and Windows. Give it a task in plain language and it works across your files, browser and apps, inside a sandbox that only touches folders you approve. It can run whichever model fits each job.

records.name: Kept
records.tagline: your team's docs, answered locally
records.description: A private AI for tech teams that answers questions from your own docs, runbooks and policies, citing the exact passage. It runs entirely on a Mac you own; documents and questions never leave it.

records.name: Pudding
records.tagline: A cute Mac cleaner that shows what's eating your disk
records.description: Pudding turns everything on your Mac's disk into jellies: the bigger the jelly, the more space it takes. It only suggests what's safe to delete (caches, old iPhone backups, node_modules), so one click gets your space back. Free, and it runs entirely on your Mac. A jelly pet that lives on your desktop is free for the first 30 days.

records.name: RootMind
records.tagline: Ask all your local documents a question.
records.description: Ever wished or tried to drag a folder of docs into an LLM-Chat? Use RootMind and watch your LLM doing miracles! - Local document search with an agentic LLM loop - No embeddings! - Indexes selected folders, does OCR decoding of images and pdf's (scanned docs) - Answers cite the page - MCP server - Windows & Linux desktop app - Works with local LLMs also and even on mobile phones via Claude Code for example - Way better than Windows search

records.name: SquidFace AI
records.tagline: Create video, images, music, voice and 3D from one prompt
records.description: Built for creators, marketers and small businesses who want studio-quality content, fast and affordably. Free to start — available on web and Android, soon line Apple

records.name: Dermi: AI Skin Analyzer & Acne
records.tagline: AI mole checker & skin analysis. Track moles, rash & acne.
records.description: Dermi is an AI skin scanner and mole checker that helps you understand your skin and track every change. Snap a photo of a mole, spot, rash or acne and get a clear AI skin analysis in seconds — then save it and re-check over time. Free AI scans every day: you get 5 credits daily to scan, compare and ask questions. No ads, and no free trial needed to start.

records.name: Copy That Video
records.tagline: Copy any viral AI video with one photo
records.description: Copy That Video turns the AI video trends going viral on TikTok into one-photo templates. Pick a trend or paste the TikTok link you saw, add one clear photo, and get the same vertical video starring you, with its sound and no watermark. Trend pages include Cat Dance AI, Christmas video, Chipmunks Dance and more. There's also text-to-video and image-to-video. Pricing is one-time credit packs with no subscription; credits never expire, and failed renders refund their credits.
